description: This file declares interfaces and includes necessary headers for parsing and processing telemetry configuration data using cJSON and MsgPack formats. It defines function signatures for configuration processing, message extraction, and printing functions related to MsgPack objects.
external_methods: cjson functions (not explicitly listed, but implied through header inclusion)

methods.name: processConfiguration
methods.description: Processes configuration data given as a JSON string, profile name, and hash, updating the provided Profile object.

methods.name: msgpack_get_map_value
methods.description: Retrieves a value from a MsgPack map object given a key.

methods.name: msgpack_get_array_element
methods.description: Retrieves an element from a MsgPack array at a specified index.

methods.name: msgpack_strdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string from a MsgPack object.

methods.name: msgpack_print
methods.description: Prints the MsgPack object with an associated name.

methods.name: msgpack_strcmp
methods.description: Compares a MsgPack string object with a C string.

methods.name: processMsgPackConfiguration
methods.description: Processes a MsgPack array or map to extract profiles into a Profile pointer.
